title: the ticket machine commits the crossed component's history and state when Ticket.passed or Ticket.failed returns, and publishes the helper
intention: Ticket.passed and Ticket.failed each end by committing the crossed component's history.json and state.json, path-limited, through one helper the ticket machine publishes in its public_interface, so a gate's crossing never sits as uncommitted dirt on one disk.
why: Measured 2026-11-19 on akiendell: 2026-11-19 akiendell: five crossings sat uncommitted in the house tree (tester seq 408, codemother seq 172, verdict seq 32, chart_gate seq 9 and 10), landed by hand on akiendell-1eee-fixme-record (0065e73b6). Read: ticket.py:311 passed and :337 failed call transitions.emit and write the cursor with no git call; chart_gate/gate.py:253 _fail reaches the FIXME crossing only through Ticket.failed, which wrote tester seq 408, codemother seq 172 and verdict seq 32 (actor codemother). Law 7: a crossing that exists on one disk is not permanent.
traces_to: Law 7 (permanent in records of truth); Law 4 (physics, not a hand remembering sail step 10); RULE 1 (a ticket's build lives inside its own component).
how: A hypothesis, measured by the proof: ticket.py gains commit_crossing_records(history_path, state_path, why), which stages and commits only those two files; Ticket.passed and Ticket.failed call it after their crossing lands; it is named in cairn/machines/ticket/intention+why.json public_interface for sail.py (ee9637b02525) and clearance.py (sibling ticket) to call. It stays out of projector.append_entry, which scratch proofs call.

clauses.claim: after Ticket.failed sends a ticket to FIXME (the chart gate's _fail path, actor codemother), the component's history.json and state.json are committed and git status of those two paths is clean
after Ticket.passed crosses a ticket forward, the same two files are committed and clean
another ticket's dirty records in the same tree are not staged or committed by either
projector.append_entry still makes no git call: a scratch proof that appends an entry leaves the tree with only its own writes
commit_crossing_records is named in the ticket machine's public_interface and, called alone on a dirty component, commits only that component's history.json and state.json

decisions.text: D1: Ticket.passed and Ticket.failed each end by committing the crossed component's history.json and state.json, path-limited, through one helper the ticket machine publishes in its public_interface, so a gate's crossing never sits as uncommitted dirt on one disk.
D2: the red-first proof drives a scratch crossing, one tooth per clause, PROVES declared.
